title: Sum of even numbers
source: HumanEval / HackerRank canonical: filter+reduce over a number array — the single most common intro coding-eval primitive.
signature: function sumEvens(nums)  // nums: number[] -> number (sum of the even values)
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `sumEvens(nums)` that takes an array of integers and returns the sum of only the even numbers. If there are no even numbers, return 0. Negative even numbers count.
